intent: Vertical sequence of now, next, and later for ordered multi-stage work.
useWhen: Status order matters more than dates or magnitudes
doNotUseWhen: Numbered wizard or checkout steps — use ProgressSteps

items.note: { id?, title?, body?, phase?, status?: now|next|later }[]. The phase line always starts with the status word (Now, Next, Later), then the phase if it says something else.

requirements: One now step at a time in content
Each step names its status as a word, not only by dot colour

doNot: Do not use Timeline for numbered wizard steps — use ProgressSteps
